description: E-cigarette users and dual users — those who use both conventional cigarettes and e-cigarettes — are associated with a higher prevalence of metabolic syndrome and declining lung function, according to a recent study by the Korea Medical Institute. description: South Korean stocks started sharply lower Monday amid lingering volatility in the market sparked by the Middle East conflict and rising oil prices.
